selected_evidence.requirement: Local backend on TCP 8091 returns backend-ready
selected_evidence.summary: Shows backend-8091 enabled and active, listening on 127.0.0.1:8091, and returning HTTP 200 with `backend-ready`.
Shows nginx listening on 0.0.0.0/[::]:8090 and returning HTTP 200 with `backend-ready` through 10.100.70.10; matching request logs and proxy_pass configuration prove forwarding to port 8091.
Shows TCP 8090 allowed persistently and at runtime while backend TCP 8091 remains unpublished.

Captures healthy baseline boot ID e31962a9-8d32-4c19-8dd2-0b96a45c6c48, safe reboot acknowledgment, changed boot ID f42bbaf1-7b0e-45df-a8d2-379293612acc, and complete post-restart service/listener/HTTP/firewall recovery.
Shows both services active, correct listeners, direct and proxied HTTP 200 responses, and the same post-restart request recorded by nginx and the backend.

set -eu
install -d -m 0755 /usr/local/libexec
cat > /usr/local/libexec/backend-8091.py <<'ANTRIEB_BACKEND_PY'
#!/usr/bin/python3
from http.server import BaseHTTPRequestHandler, ThreadingHTTPServer

BODY = b"backend-ready\n"

class Handler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    protocol_version = "HTTP/1.1"

    def do_GET(self):
        self.send_response(200)
        self.send_header("Content-Type", "text/plain; charset=utf-8")
        self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(BODY)))
        self.send_header("Connection", "close")
        self.end_headers()
        self.wfile.write(BODY)

    def log_message(self, format, *args):
        super().log_message(format, *args)

ThreadingHTTPServer(("127.0.0.1", 8091), Handler).serve_forever()
ANTRIEB_BACKEND_PY
chmod 0755 /usr/local/libexec/backend-8091.py
cat > /etc/systemd/system/backend-8091.service <<'ANTRIEB_BACKEND_UNIT'
[Unit]
Description=Local HTTP backend on TCP 8091
After=network-online.target
Wants=network-online.target

[Service]
Type=simple
User=nobody
Group=nobody
ExecStart=/usr/bin/python3 /usr/local/libexec/backend-8091.py
Restart=always
RestartSec=2s
NoNewPrivileges=true
PrivateTmp=true
ProtectHome=true
ProtectSystem=strict

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
ANTRIEB_BACKEND_UNIT
